text: 1. The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen, with good conduct and good health; abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations; respect Chinese customs and traditions, and be pro-China and friendly towards China. 2. Applicant's age: 18 years old and above, under 60 years old. (If the applicant is under 18 years old and the parents are not permanently residing in China, the parents are required to provide an authorization and power of attorney certificate, entrusting a person with guardianship ability who is permanently residing in China to act as the legal guardian of the student, and providing relevant proof materials of the guardian.)
